responsibility: Defines the interned `ty::Const` wrapper and its constructors, literal lowering, value/expression forms, and extraction helpers that bridge type-level constants with valtrees, scalars, unevaluated consts, and inference placeholders.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/consts.rs`, which represents constants in MIR and interpreter-facing forms like `ConstValue`, this file defines the type-system constant wrapper `ty::Const`, its interned `ConstKind` forms, and helpers for lowering literals and working with valtrees, inference, and type-level unevaluated consts.
